ideal: Alert with two lines: Tesla 8-K with quarterly earnings results (link) and Meta 8-K with earnings plus a material agreement and other events (link); skip Microsoft's proxy/annual report paperwork and Meta's PRE 14C.

verdicts.note: Covers both earnings 8-Ks accurately with links, skips the proxy paperwork, though it could say more plainly why they matter.
verdicts.answer:
Tesla: filed a current-events report (8-K) covering quarterly results (earnings) — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026066738/tsla-20261021.htm

Meta Platforms: filed a current-events report (8-K) including a material agreement, quarterly results, and other events — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828026066700/meta-20261019.htm

verdicts.note: Alerting was right, but it misses Tesla's earnings and leaves out that Meta's 8-K contains earnings.
verdicts.answer: Meta Platforms: entered a material agreement via 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828026066700/meta-20261019.htm)

verdicts.note: Staying silent misses two earnings releases she explicitly wants to hear about.
